notes.title: update v1.06.21
notes.content: In this update joining to the public room with code starting from zeroes was fixed.

notes.title: Rapid patch has been released!
notes.content:
Hey, we've received a lot of feedback about the bug that was accidentally added with the last patch. 
We are really sorry for that, but we are glad to say, that the hotfix has been released. Please update your game to fix this issue.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.21
notes.content: - Fixed bug with player head "floating over the table"

notes.title: Bullet Roulette update is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35416342/c8ede3de6529bc0a990b378de980f1040999df2f.jpg[/img]

Hello dear friends!
We are happy to say, that today, on 19th January Bullet Roulette VR receives an update with several enhancements. We will continue to support Bullet Roulette further, thank you for being with us!

Update contains:
- Bug with Public Enemy card is fixed
- New pianist music compositions are added
- The pianist is not resurrecting after each round now
- Bug with a mysterious extra bullet on a table is now fixed
- Other fixes and improvements

notes.title: First major update of Bullet Roulette VR
notes.content:
Hello dear friends!
Thank you for all your support and reviews. We have been looking through all your comments and we are glad to announce that Bullet Roulette VR reaches its first big milestone.

Update contains:
[list]
[*] Major bugfixes according to your feedback
[*] Audio and microphone settings were added
[*] Interfaces were updated
[*] Сard descriptions have been added
[*] AI players become more aggressive and cunning
[*] Bullet Roulette now supports WMR 
[*] Revised revolver grabbing
[/list]
